driver.requiredReceipt: Independent driver review binds every artifact SHA256, the Authority and authorized-client public key digests, Node24, both writer SIDs, the Job Object lifecycle fix and zero additional privileged imports.
driver.composition: The Controller generates an Authority signing keypair and per-Task authorized Online client keypairs, then creates each child with host-create.exe: an OWNER RIGHTS SID (S-1-3-4) access-denied ACE over STANDARD_RIGHTS_ALL, an explicit stdin/stdout/stderr handle list, and a kill-on-close Job Object assigned before the initial thread resumes. Secrets travel only over the parent's stdin pipe. The protected directory is prepared by the Controller with explicit ACLs; Offline owns every registry and anchor mutation; Online alone receives the GitHub token, real Octokit and its client private key.
driver.credentialBoundary: Ordinary Owner and Online hold RX only on the protected directory and its files; Offline holds F; SYSTEM and Administrators hold F. The Authority re-runs harden and assert before every request and mutation and refuses to sign if any unexpected principal, M/F grant or delete-child appears. Selected processes are unreadable and unmodifiable by same-SID siblings, and a same-SID sibling cannot terminate them either; the Job Object guarantees termination when the Controller exits.
physicalPrincipalProbes: Creation-time deny ACE probe: same-SID OpenProcess VM_READ=0, VM_OPERATION=0, WRITE_DAC=0, DUP_HANDLE=0.
Job Object lifecycle probe: after killing the Controller the guarded child disappeared within 0 ms and no host-create process remained.

physicalDesign.authority: One shared SQLite CAS document per documented registryId, mutated only by the selected Offline Authority; Online submits signed requests and reads signed responses.
physicalDesign.atomicity: The complete lease set is a single CAS document. Acquisition re-reads and validates the whole document, compares every exclusive resource and adds one lease with mustBeAbsent for first initialisation or mustMatchRevision thereafter. At most 16 attempts, then HOST_FENCE_CONTENTION_EXHAUSTED with no effect.
physicalDesign.continuousPossession: The owner nonce is retained only in the authorized Online process; only its SHA256 enters the registry. Every assertion re-reads the document, validates registryId, fenceId, stable fenceRevision, nonce hash and exact binding, then signs the response. Leases never expire; the holder never releases during an in-flight effect.
physicalDesign.stableIdentity: fenceId and fenceRevision are assigned once at acquisition and never change when unrelated leases update the CAS row; the row revision is separate and never reused as fenceRevision.
physicalDesign.lifetime: Release is legal only before an external effect and requires preEffect:true; post-effect release is a hard error. Successful or ambiguous publication keeps the lease for reconciliation; a restarted process has no nonce and cannot assert, release or reacquire.
physicalDesign.registryRecreation: An absent document is the only first-initialisation path. Any later absence, changed registryId, generation regression or malformed document denies; the document is never deleted by this code.
physicalDesign.rollbackAnchor: An append-only signed anchor chain records registryId, generation, complete snapshot digest and previous anchor hash. The expected head lives only in Authority memory; a restart refuses all operations until a separately reviewed Owner reconciliation. Same-ID rollback, anchor-only replacement, truncation and CAS-success/anchor-failure all deny before any response is signed.
physicalDesign.resourceCompatibility: The port derives compatibility from durable foreign leases and their exact frozen resource objects; projected claim rows in the request are never trusted as resource identity.
physicalDesign.publisherFence: FUTURE_INTEGRATION_ONLY: asserting a held lease immediately before and after an external POST belongs to the deferred wiring revision, not to this library increment.

canonicalResourceContract.bytes: UTF-8 JSON.stringify of a recursive canonical value: object keys sorted by code unit, arrays in semantic order, exotic values rejected.
canonicalResourceContract.frozenSetDigest: SHA256(canonicalBytes({schema, repository, issueRef, protectedClaimKey, generation, sourceSha, dispatchId, taskPackRef, taskPackBlobSha, reviewRef, ownerApprovalRef, writeSetSha256, exclusiveResources})).
canonicalResourceContract.bindingVersusConflict: Identity fields bind the lease; only exclusiveResources participate in conflict comparison, though identity equality is mandatory for possession.
canonicalResourceContract.file: Git repo-relative UTF-8 paths only: forward slashes, no empty/dot/dot-dot segment, no backslash, drive letter, absolute or trailing slash. Original spelling is binding metadata. On the required Windows Host, comparison case-folds before exact and path-segment ancestor checks, so case-only spellings always conflict; unknown case or filesystem semantics deny.
canonicalResourceContract.cas: Exact validated CAS key; only equality conflicts.
canonicalResourceContract.githubIssueComment: Repository plus numeric Issue; the same Issue conflicts, different Issues are disjoint.
canonicalResourceContract.gitRef: Validated refs/* name using code-unit comparison; exact or path-component ancestor conflicts.
canonicalResourceContract.unknown: Unknown kinds, duplicates or ambiguous identity deny.
